intro.heading: Artists and technicians, working for your art.
intro.body: Matr was started by artists, and the studio still runs on that instinct. Every finish we offer was developed alongside artists, to make their work look its best. Choose how you want to work with us.

tiers.name: Studio+
tiers.title: More from a single image.
tiers.body: Anything from the menu below, on top of what an Oil Edition offers: texture you can feel, relief, custom grounds, or color on wood, metal or fabric.
tiers.pricing: Tell us what you have in mind, and we'll shape and price it with you.
tiers.alt: A hand working fine lines into a textured surface with a thin brush

tiers.name: Studio Pro
tiers.title: Your production studio.
tiers.body: We develop your look with you through samples, then produce and deliver it in quantity, edition after edition.
tiers.pricing: An upfront development fee covers the sampling; volume pricing earns it back.
tiers.alt: A run of richly textured pieces laid out together on the print bed

menu.heading: The Studio+ menu
menu.lead: Finishes we can bring to your image. Combine them, or ask us what would suit your work.

items.title: Gestural texture
items.body: Marks worked by hand into the surface before the color goes on. Every piece carries the trace of a hand, and no two are alike.
items.alt: A richly textured surface with visible gestural marks

items.title: Image-led texture
items.body: Texture drawn from your image itself, following its forms and movement, and repeatable across an edition.
items.alt: Texture following the flow of an image

items.title: Sculpted relief
items.body: Relief built up layer by layer, as crisp and exact as your file.
items.alt: A print with crisp raised relief

items.title: Custom mediums
items.body: We mix the surface for your piece. Here, marble dust in both the oil ground and wet medium gives a gritty texture and a subtle, shimmering sparkle.
items.alt: A gritty surface with a fine mineral sparkle

items.title: Beyond canvas
items.body: Your image on wood, metal, paper, fabric, even cement.
items.alt: A face printed directly onto rough, pitted cement

items.title: Relief beneath oil
items.body: Precise, built-up relief, finished in our signature oil-based color.
items.alt: A sign image with raised relief under a glossy oil-color surface

items.title: Atmospheric color
items.body: Oil-based color sprayed on as a fine, continuous mist, for soft gradients and a hand-sprayed feel.
items.alt: A soft, glowing image with misted gradients

items.title: Raised line
items.body: Fine lines drawn in relief across the surface, so pattern and contour stand up off the image.
items.alt: Fine raised white lines forming a pattern across a printed surface
